recent.text: For the past three weeks, the Spurs lived a charmed life, winning 12 games in a row and largely avoiding the injury bug that afflicted other teams. Tuesday offered a double dose of reality, as the Spurs lost to Detroit and lost Dylan Harper to injury. https://t.co/E9RC6h9sNd

recent.text: The #Spurs have ruled out guard Dylan Harper for Thursday night's home game against the Los Angeles Clippers due to left hip "soreness." https://t.co/KDWPTLeBZX
recent.author: Tom Orsborn

recent.text: Spurs officially designate Harper's injury as left hip soreness. Tobias Harris remains sidelined due to the left calf strain he suffered early in training camp.
recent.author: Tom Orsborn

recent.text: Harper will undergo further testing, at which point they will have a better handle on a timetable for his return. For now, doesn't sound as serious as it looked but we'll have to wait and see.
recent.author: Jeff McDonald
recent.quoted_text: As expected, Spurs guard Dylan Harper will be listed as OUT Thursday against the Clippers with what the team is for now calling hip soreness. Another update is expected at some point tomorrow.

recent.text: Spurs are expected to release more information on Harper's injury tomorrow after they receive more information from the medical staff.

recent.text: Wemby on seeing Dylan Harper in pain after slipping on the court late in the loss to Detroit: "It's a terrible feeling, terrible sight. I know as much as you guys, so I hope he's fine...But, yeah, I just hate this. I don't know how else I can say this." #Spurs

recent.text: Mitch on Dylan Harper suffering an apparent injury with 53.6 left in the loss to Detroit: "It just looked like he slipped, obviously, so hoping for the best, but don't know anything yet." Harper limped off the court and headed to the locker room with help from Keldon Johnson.

recent.text: Well Dylan Harper is down in obvious pain after slipping and falling down. He's needing some assistance to get off the court. This is sub-optimal.

recent.text: A) They didn't really "get killed" in the non-Wemby minutes last season, and Kornet was a big reason why B) The guy they signed to bolster the bench has been out since training camp with a calf injury. Harris should help once he's cleared.
recent.author: Jeff McDonald
recent.quoted_text: Thank you to Brian Wright for recognizing we got killed in the non wemby minutes last year and did nothing to improve it!

recent.text: Are you applauding the Spurs for drafting Victor Wembanyama? It was a fairly easy call, from what I remember.

recent.text: In the process of reviewing a potential flagrant foul against Julian Champagnie, it looks like it might not even be a foul at all. By rule, officials can't overturn the common foul call here, though.
